note: Shoshone NF campground where Frontier Creek meets the Wiggins Fork on the edge of the Washakie Wilderness, 28 miles north of Dubois on gravel Forest Road 285. Wilderness trails start here, including the Frontier Creek Trail to a petrified forest (removing petrified wood is illegal). --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-23) read: 14 units, 32-ft max spur, FCFS (no rec.gov), 16-day limit, $20 cash/check, vault toilets, no potable water, mid-May to Labor Day. Sites, facilities, booking, fees, season written. Not waterfront holds. Pin good. Phone empty -> 307-455-2466.
